baselines.gated_deltanet: Gated DeltaNet recurrence baseline without archive.
baselines.per_page_midpoint_comparator: Equation (13) per-page completion with p_j = c_j and B_j = U_j ρ_j.
baselines.recurrence_free_archive: Sparse/archive attention without recurrent prediction (using r=0 or local barycenter predictor).
baselines.ssm_hybrid: Alternating Mamba-2 / SSD selective state-space scan and local attention.
baselines.transformer_gqa: Modern causal Transformer with RoPE rotary embeddings, Pre-RMSNorm, SwiGLU MLP, GQA grouped-query attention.

stop_conditions: NaN or Inf detected in loss, gradients, or recurrent state
Loss divergence (> 100.0 on standard LM cross-entropy)
Evaluation non-convergence or zero backward gradient

data_provenance_plan.accuracy_and_recall: Computed by exact string/token match on test sequences; raw model logits and predictions logged to JSONL; commit hash and checkpoint ID attached to every output.
data_provenance_plan.error_certificate: Evaluated by computing ||y_* - y_hat||_2 against fp64 full softmax truth; certificate bound correctness checked for 100% enclosure.
data_provenance_plan.latency: Timed using high-resolution perf_counter(); JAX block_until_ready() or PyTorch synchronize() called before and after; warmups recorded separately; measurements run with populated cache tensors.
data_provenance_plan.loss_and_nll: Calculated directly via cross-entropy loss over held-out tokens; per-batch loss arrays serialized to disk; no smoothed or synthetic proxies.
data_provenance_plan.memory: Measured via psutil resident set size (RSS) and tensor allocation counters; page table and index metadata explicitly accounted.

multi_hop_pointer.description: 2-hop and 4-hop mixed cache/remote pointer chasing chains

synthetic_mqar.description: Multi-Query Associative Recall with variable key-value pairs and distractor tokens

H1.falsification_criterion: Per-step bounded decode time scales super-linearly with context length.
H1.name: Solve-free bounded execution eliminates key-space matrix inversion complexity
H1.statement: Solve-free bounded execution achieves constant-per-token decode complexity O(d_v d_k + w(d_k + d_v)) without key-space matrix factorizations.

H2.falsification_criterion: Measured cost improvement < 10% or paired 95% confidence interval includes zero at registered epsilon values on held-out tasks.
H2.name: Recurrent completion lowers measured cost at fixed certified error
H2.statement: Recurrent completion (Eq. 8, using r(q) = v̄_L + S(q - k̄_L)) lowers measured retrieval cost (pages/bytes fetched) at fixed certified error tolerance ε relative to the best recurrence-free completion (r = 0, r = barycenter, or Eq. 13 per-page completion).

H3.falsification_criterion: Fallback rate > 5.0%, or p99 latency > 25 ms, or validation NLL degradation > 1.0% relative to dense Transformer baseline.
H3.name: Archive mode preserves held-out task quality with acceptable systems metrics
H3.statement: Archive mode preserves held-out task quality (MQAR, Passkey, LM validation NLL) while meeting registered SLOs: p99 decode latency ≤ 25 ms, fallback rate ≤ 5.0%, and acceptable memory footprint.

H4.falsification_criterion: Validation NLL degradation > 5.0% relative to matched SSM Hybrid baseline, or complete failure on short-to-medium recall tasks within the state capacity.
H4.name: Trained bounded mode has useful quality at its fixed state budget
H4.statement: Trained bounded mode (without archive) retains competitive quality on language modeling and associative recall within its fixed recurrent state budget O(d_v d_k + w(d_k + d_v)).
